---
title: "Stop and search evidence briefing"

  html_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    toc_float:
      collapsed: false
    theme: default
    css: briefing.css
    fig_caption: true
    self_contained: true
  word_document:
    toc: false
    reference_docx: briefing-reference.docx
    fig_caption: true
    pandoc_args: ["--columns=200"]
  pdf_document:
    toc: true
    toc_depth: 2
    fig_caption: true
    latex_engine: pdflatex
    extra_dependencies: ["booktabs", "float"]
papersize: a4
geometry: margin=2.2cm
fontsize: 12pt
params:
  force: "metropolitan"
  council: null
  year: null
  release: null
  draws: 2000
  seed: 1
---

```{r setup, include = FALSE}
html <- knitr::is_html_output()
latex <- knitr::is_latex_output()
# Figures fill the text width: vector graphics in PDF, print resolution in Word.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, out.width = "100%",
                      fig.width = if (html) 10 else 7.5, fig.height = if (html) 6.2 else 4.9,
                      dpi = if (html) 144 else 200,
                      dev = if (latex && isTRUE(capabilities("cairo"))) "cairo_pdf" else "png")
# the briefing states sources and qualifications itself, so charts carry only their coverage note
options(BlackThriveSS.caption = "short")
if (html) {
  knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.align = "left")
} else {
  # alternative text is an HTML feature; other outputs take the figure alone
  knitr::opts_hooks$set(fig.alt = function(options) { options$fig.alt <- NULL; options })
}
if (latex) knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.pos = "H")
if (!isNamespaceLoaded("BlackThriveSS")) library(BlackThriveSS)
profile <- btg_profile(force = params$force, council = params$council, year = params$year,
                       release = params$release, draws = params$draws, seed = params$seed)
is_force <- identical(profile$area$level, "force")
area_arg <- if (is_force) list(force = profile$area$id) else list(council = profile$area$id)
dataset <- if (is_force) "force_ethnicity_year" else "council_ethnicity_year"
area_data <- do.call(btg_get_data, c(list(dataset = dataset, release = profile$release), area_arg))
year_data <- btg_get_data(dataset, years = profile$year, release = profile$release)
fmt <- function(x, digits = 1) format(round(x, digits), nsmall = digits, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
count <- function(x) format(x, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
ratio_text <- function(x) ifelse(is.finite(x), paste0(fmt(x), "x"), "n/a")
interval_text <- function(lo, hi, digits = 1) ifelse(is.finite(lo), paste0(fmt(lo, digits), "x to ", fmt(hi, digits), "x"), "")
cmp <- profile$comparisons
black <- cmp[cmp$group == "Black", ]
source_year <- as.integer(substr(profile$source_month, 1, 4))
period <- if (source_year == profile$year) sprintf("January to %s %d", format(as.Date(paste0(profile$source_month, "-01")), "%B"), profile$year) else as.character(profile$year)
previous <- if (!is.null(profile$change)) profile$change[profile$change$group == "Black", ] else NULL
# LaTeX numbers tables and figures itself; the other outputs take the number from here.
figure <- local({ n <- 0; function() { n <<- n + 1; if (latex) "" else sprintf("Figure %d.", n) } })
table_n <- local({ n <- 0; function() { n <<- n + 1; if (latex) "" else sprintf("Table %d.", n) } })
numbered <- function(prefix, text) trimws(paste(prefix, text))
# Raw HTML is dropped by Word and PDF output, so prose with a class is written by these.
lede <- function(text) if (html) cat('<p class="btg-lede">', text, '</p>\n', sep = "") else cat(text, "\n\n", sep = "")
note <- function(text) if (html) cat('<p class="btg-note">', text, '</p>\n', sep = "") else cat("*", text, "*\n\n", sep = "")
```

# `r profile$area$label`, `r profile$year`

```{r lede, results = "asis"}
lede(sprintf("Recorded stop and search in %s during %s, compared with the area's White residents, with the uncertainty and coverage that any reading of the numbers should carry. Every figure is built from fixed, checksummed public data bundled with the BlackThriveSS package (release %s, Police.uk source month %s, Census 2021 resident populations) and can be reproduced in R from the code at the end.",
             profile$area$label, period, profile$release, profile$source_month))
```

## At a glance

```{r glance, results = "asis"}
cards <- list()
if (is.finite(black$ratio)) {
  cards[[length(cards) + 1]] <- list(label = "Black:White stop-rate ratio", value = ratio_text(black$ratio),
    detail = if (is.finite(black$ci_lower)) paste("95% interval", interval_text(black$ci_lower, black$ci_upper)) else "")
}
if (is_force && isTRUE(black$eligible) && !is.na(black$rank)) {
  cards[[length(cards) + 1]] <- list(label = "Rank among eligible forces", value = sprintf("%d of %d", black$rank, black$n_eligible),
    detail = if (!is.null(black$rank_lower) && !is.na(black$rank_lower)) sprintf("Sampling alone: between %d and %d", black$rank_lower, black$rank_upper) else "")
}
if (is.finite(black$unknown_share)) {
  cards[[length(cards) + 1]] <- list(label = "Stops with unknown ethnicity", value = paste0(fmt(100 * black$unknown_share), "%"),
    detail = sprintf("%s of %s recorded stops", count(black$unknown_ethnicity_stops), count(black$total_records)))
}
if (is_force) {
  cards[[length(cards) + 1]] <- list(label = "Monthly returns supplied", value = sprintf("%d of 12", profile$coverage$months_supplied),
    detail = switch(profile$coverage$status, all_months_supplied = "Every month of the year",
                    partial_year = sprintf("%d month(s) missing", profile$coverage$months_missing),
                    no_months_supplied = "No returns in this release", unverified = "Outside the verified window"))
}
if (!is.null(previous) && is.finite(previous$change)) {
  cards[[length(cards) + 1]] <- list(label = sprintf("Change since %d", previous$year_from),
    value = sprintf("%+.0f%%", 100 * (previous$change - 1)),
    detail = if (is.finite(previous$change_lower)) paste("Interval", interval_text(previous$change_lower, previous$change_upper, 2),
                                                        if (isTRUE(previous$comparable_coverage)) "" else "(coverage differs)") else "")
}
if (html) {
  cat('<div class="btg-cards">\n')
  for (c in cards) cat(sprintf('<div class="btg-card"><div class="label">%s</div><div class="value">%s</div><div class="detail">%s</div></div>\n', c$label, c$value, c$detail))
  cat('</div>\n')
} else {
  glance <- data.frame(Measure = vapply(cards, `[[`, "", "label"), Value = vapply(cards, `[[`, "", "value"),
                       Detail = vapply(cards, `[[`, "", "detail"), check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  print(btg_table(glance, caption = numbered(table_n(), "At a glance"), align = c("l", "r", "l")))
}
```

## Headline findings

```{r findings, results = "asis"}
for (i in seq_len(nrow(profile$topics))) {
  topic <- profile$topics$topic[i]
  lines <- unname(profile$statements[names(profile$statements) == topic])
  # the ratio and its rank first; what the unknown stops and the previous year add second
  paragraphs <- if (length(lines) > 2) c(paste(lines[1:2], collapse = " "), paste(lines[-(1:2)], collapse = " ")) else paste(lines, collapse = " ")
  for (j in seq_along(paragraphs)) {
    lead <- if (j == 1) sprintf("**%s.** ", profile$topics$heading[i]) else ""
    if (html) {
      cat(sprintf('<p class="btg-finding">%s%s</p>\n', sub("^\\*\\*(.*)\\*\\* $", "<strong>\\1</strong> ", lead), paragraphs[j]))
    } else {
      cat(lead, paragraphs[j], "\n\n", sep = "")
    }
  }
}
```

## Comparisons with White residents

```{r comparisons}
rates <- data.frame(
  Group = cmp$group,
  `Recorded stops` = count(cmp$group_stops),
  `Per 1,000 residents` = fmt(cmp$group_rate),
  `White per 1,000` = fmt(cmp$white_rate),
  Ratio = ratio_text(cmp$ratio),
  `95% interval` = interval_text(cmp$ci_lower, cmp$ci_upper),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
btg_table(rates, caption = numbered(table_n(), sprintf("Recorded stops and rates per 1,000 residents by ethnic group, %s", period)),
          align = c("l", rep("r", 5)))
```

```{r rates-note, results = "asis"}
note("Rates divide recorded stop events by Census 2021 residents; the interval reflects sampling variability on the recorded counts only. A ratio is descriptive and does not establish discrimination.")
```

```{r robustness-table}
robust <- data.frame(
  Group = cmp$group,
  `Ratio range` = interval_text(cmp$ratio_min, cmp$ratio_max),
  `Side of parity` = ifelse(is.na(cmp$parity_direction), "", c(above = "Above", below = "Below", sensitive = "Depends")[cmp$parity_direction]),
  check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
if (is_force) {
  robust$Rank <- ifelse(cmp$eligible, sprintf("%d of %d", cmp$rank, cmp$n_eligible), "none")
  robust$`Rank interval` <- if (!is.null(cmp$rank_lower)) ifelse(is.na(cmp$rank_lower), "", paste(cmp$rank_lower, "to", cmp$rank_upper)) else ""
  robust$`Rank range` <- ifelse(is.na(cmp$rank_best), "", paste(cmp$rank_best, "to", cmp$rank_worst))
}
btg_table(robust, caption = numbered(table_n(), sprintf("How robust each comparison is, %s", period)),
          align = c("l", "r", "l", rep("r", ncol(robust) - 3)))
```

```{r robust-note, results = "asis"}
note("The ratio range is what the ratio would be if every stop with no recorded ethnicity were counted as White (lower end) or as the compared group (upper end); any allocation lies between them. The side of parity says whether the whole range sits above or below 1, or depends on those stops. The rank interval comes from redrawing the recorded counts (sampling); the rank range from allocating every force's unknown stops for or against this one.")
```

```{r ranking, eval = is_force, fig.height = if (html) 6.5 else 5.2, fig.cap = if (is_force) numbered(figure(), paste("Black:White stop-rate ratios for the ten highest-ranked forces, with", profile$area$label, "highlighted where it falls among them. Bars are recorded ratios with 95% Poisson intervals; a lighter bar and an asterisk mark incomplete or unverified returns.")), fig.alt = "Ranking of forces by Black to White stop-rate ratio with this force highlighted."}
if (is_force && any(year_data$data$eligible[year_data$data$group == "Black"])) {
  btg_plot_disparity(year_data, year = profile$year, group = "Black", highlight = profile$area$id)
}
```

```{r robustness, eval = is_force, fig.height = if (html) 6.5 else 5.2, fig.cap = if (is_force) numbered(figure(), "The same forces on a logarithmic axis: dots are recorded ratios, dark lines their 95% Poisson intervals, and light bands the range of each ratio if every stop with unknown ethnicity were counted as White or as Black."), fig.alt = "Recorded ratios with sampling intervals and bounds under unknown ethnicity."}
if (is_force && any(year_data$data$eligible[year_data$data$group == "Black"])) {
  btg_plot_sensitivity(year_data, year = profile$year, group = "Black", highlight = profile$area$id)
}
```

## Over time

```{r trend, fig.cap = numbered(figure(), "Stop-rate ratios compared with White residents by year, with 95% Poisson intervals; hollow markers show years the source does not cover in full. Resident populations are fixed at Census 2021."), fig.alt = "Stop-rate ratios by group and year for this area."}
btg_plot_trend(area_data)
```

```{r trend-rate, fig.cap = numbered(figure(), "Recorded stops per 1,000 residents by year, Black emphasised and the other groups as context."), fig.alt = "Recorded stops per 1,000 residents by group and year for this area."}
btg_plot_trend(area_data, measure = "rate", highlight = "Black")
```

```{r change}
if (!is.null(profile$change)) {
  ch <- profile$change
  changes <- data.frame(
    Group = ch$group,
    `Earlier ratio` = ratio_text(ch$ratio_from),
    `Later ratio` = ratio_text(ch$ratio_to),
    Change = ifelse(is.finite(ch$change), sprintf("%+.0f%%", 100 * (ch$change - 1)), ""),
    `95% interval` = interval_text(ch$change_lower, ch$change_upper, 2),
    `Both years covered in full` = ifelse(ch$comparable_coverage, "Yes", "No"),
    check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  btg_table(changes, caption = numbered(table_n(), sprintf("Change in stop-rate ratios from %d to %d", ch$year_from[1], ch$year_to[1])),
            align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "l"))
}
```

```{r change-note, results = "asis"}
if (!is.null(profile$change)) note("Change is the later ratio divided by the earlier one. A change between a fully covered year and an incomplete one is not a change in policing.")
```

```{r section60, eval = is_force}
if (is_force && !is.null(profile$section60) && nrow(profile$section60)) {
  s60 <- profile$section60
  total <- sum(s60$s60_stops, na.rm = TRUE)
  btg_table(data.frame(Group = s60$group, Searches = count(s60$s60_stops),
                       `Share of Section 60 searches` = if (total > 0) paste0(fmt(100 * s60$s60_stops / total), "%") else rep("", nrow(s60)),
                       check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
            caption = numbered(table_n(), sprintf("Searches under Section 60 by ethnic group, %s", period)), align = c("l", "r", "r"))
}
```

```{r section60-trend, eval = is_force, fig.cap = if (is_force) numbered(figure(), "Section 60 searches by ethnic group and year."), fig.alt = "Section 60 searches by group and year for this force."}
s60_years <- tryCatch(btg_get_data("section60_force_year", force = profile$area$id, release = profile$release),
                      error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(s60_years)) btg_plot_trend(s60_years)
```

## Reporting coverage

```{r coverage, eval = is_force}
if (is_force) {
  months <- profile$coverage$months
  btg_table(data.frame(
    Month = format(as.Date(paste0(months$month, "-01")), "%B %Y"),
    Status = c(supplied = "Supplied", missing = "Missing", unverified = "Unverified")[months$status],
    `Recorded stops` = ifelse(is.na(months$records), "", count(months$records)),
    check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
    caption = numbered(table_n(), sprintf("Monthly returns, %d", profile$year)), align = c("l", "l", "r"))
}
```

```{r coverage-note, results = "asis"}
note(if (is_force) "A supplied month is a reported submission, not proof that every event was recorded. Missing months are missing, not zero; an unverified month lies outside the window the dashboard checks." else "Council counts are located by published stop coordinates, which some forces withhold, so they undercount and carry no monthly coverage table.")
```

## National context

```{r national, fig.height = if (html) 5.8 else 4.4, fig.cap = numbered(figure(), "Share of recorded stops by ethnic group across England and Wales, by month, from all reporting forces."), fig.alt = "Share of recorded stops by ethnic group across England and Wales by month."}
btg_plot_trend(btg_get_data("national_month_ethnicity", release = profile$release), measure = "share")
```

```{r hit}
hit <- profile$national$hit_rate
btg_table(data.frame(Group = hit$group,
                     `Searches with a known outcome` = count(hit$hit_total),
                     `Outcome linked to object of search` = paste0(fmt(hit$hit_rate), "%"),
                     check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
          caption = numbered(table_n(), sprintf("Outcome-linked search rate by ethnic group, England and Wales, %s", period)),
          align = c("l", "r", "r"))
```

## How to read this briefing

```{r caveats, results = "asis"}
if (html) cat('<div class="btg-reading">\n')
cat(paste0("- ", profile$caveats), sep = "\n")
if (html) cat('\n</div>\n')
```

## Reproduce it

```{r reproduce, echo = TRUE, eval = FALSE, code = c(
  "library(BlackThriveSS)",
  sprintf("profile <- btg_profile(%s = \"%s\", year = %d, release = \"%s\")",
          profile$area$level, profile$area$id, profile$year, profile$release),
  "profile$statements",
  sprintf("area <- btg_get_data(\"%s\", %s = \"%s\", release = \"%s\")", dataset, profile$area$level, profile$area$id, profile$release),
  "btg_plot_trend(area)",
  if (is_force) sprintf("btg_plot_sensitivity(btg_get_data(\"%s\", years = %d, release = \"%s\"), highlight = \"%s\")", dataset, profile$year, profile$release, profile$area$id) else NULL,
  "btg_validate(area)")}
```

```{r citation, results = "asis"}
checks <- btg_validate(area_data)
if (html) cat('<div class="btg-footer">\n')
cat("Data citation: ", btg_citation(area_data), "\n\n", sep = "")
cat("Package citation: ", paste(format(utils::citation("BlackThriveSS"), style = "text"), collapse = " "), "\n\n", sep = "")
cat("Validation of the bundled release: ", if (all(checks$passed)) "all checks passed" else "some checks failed",
    " (", nrow(checks), " checks). Rendered ", format(Sys.Date(), "%d %B %Y"), ".\n", sep = "")
if (html) cat('</div>\n')
options(BlackThriveSS.caption = NULL)
```
